content: Privacy rules for under-13 sites: COPPA (US) - verifiable parental consent before collecting personal info incl. persistent identifiers like IP; notice on homepage; parental review/deletion rights. GDPR Art. 8 (applies in Germany - no national lower age set, so 16): a child's own consent valid only from 16 for information-society services; below that parental consent required; Recital 38 = children need special protection. Practical German ecosystem pattern: kid portals are ad-free, use fantasy-name-only comments, provide Kindgerechte Datenschutzerklärung (kids' privacy statements), and collect zero personal data (Internet-ABC, freii is 'vollständig anonym'). Implication: for a child-facing site, NO data collection is the fully compliant baseline and the least-effort path; accounts/analytics would trigger consent machinery.
